name: hermes_64
display_name: IBM HERMES PCM (14 nm, 64 cores of 256 x 256; gallo2022a, measured MVM)

validity.array_size_assumed: 64 cores of 256 x 256 PCM unit cells, chip 12 x 12 mm, core 1.2 x 1.16 mm (gallo2022a p.1-2); 8-bit PWM inputs, 12-bit ADC (p.9)
validity.notes: MVM energy and time are MEASURED on the chip (Table I p.18); the MVM energy aggregates array, ADC and PWM (p.10), so no conversion or row-drive row is declared beside it. Programming is page-sourced as a LOWER bound only; write energy, static power and every periphery row are absent and refuse by name.

e_mac.citation: gallo2022a Table I p.18 via constants.md sec. 6
e_mac.note: 9.76 TOPS/W one-phase (133 ns) and 2.48 TOPS/W four-phase (520 ns) at 8-bit input and output, 1 MAC = 2 OPs (the paper's convention): 2 / 9.76e12 J = 204.9 fJ and 2 / 2.48e12 J = 806.5 fJ per MAC. The figure contains the ADC and PWM periphery (p.10).

t_cycle.citation: gallo2022a Table I p.18 via constants.md sec. 6
t_cycle.note: One MVM: 133 ns one-phase, 520 ns four-phase. A value-domain stage evaluates once, so one MVM is one step of the value window.

area_per_core_total.note: Core 1.2 mm x 1.16 mm = 1.392 mm^2. A per-core aggregate: it holds at the 256 x 256 core of 4-bit-effective cells (validity geometry).

area_global_fixed.derivation: Chip 12 x 12 mm = 144 mm^2 less 64 cores x 1.392 mm^2 = 89.088 mm^2: 54.912 mm^2 outside the cores (gallo2022a p.1-2).

t_write_per_unit.derivation: One programming iteration of one core: 32 source lines in parallel, so 8 programming cycles per diagonal; RESET 125 ns, SET 250 ns, verify read 512 ns PWM plus 256 ns precharge; one-device programming with one verify gives at least 2.45 ms per core (0.61 ms per 16,384-weight tile).
t_write_per_unit.note: A LOWER bound per core iteration (write granularity core).

write_verify_iterations.note: 'at most 30 iterations'; the mean is not stated, so the band spans one iteration (the lower bound's own assumption) to the stated maximum, nominal at its log-space centre.

endurance_cycles.note: SECONDARY: 'about 1e6 to 1e9 conservative writes' for NVM in general, read in the X-Former paper (secondary source); the primary device citations it rests on were not read in this round (the owner's fetch list holds lee2011a for TaOx RRAM and gallo2020an for PCM, which replace this band when they land). Nominal at the band's log-space centre.
